title: Muse
subtitle: Reviewing a video your agent made

scenes.say: [ask]To get a video of your app, you ask your coding agent for one. [make]The agent writes it, sets up your screens, and checks every moment. [review]Then Muse opens in your browser. This is your part. [loop]You watch the video and leave notes, and the agent makes the changes. [final]When it's right, you approve it, and Muse renders the final video.

[page]This is Muse. [video]On the left is the video, with its captions and the narration box, the blue outline on what the voice is talking about. [side]On the right are your notes, and a list of the scenes. [top]The top bar says where the review stands. Right now it says "Not reviewed yet".

[play]Press Play to watch it, with the voice. [scrubber]The bar under the video is the whole video. Each coloured band is a scene, and each small mark is a moment when something moves. [time]Next to the buttons is the time, to the thousandth of a second.

[jump]These buttons jump to the scene before or after. [speed]Slow it down or speed it up here. [loop]Or loop one scene, to watch it again and again. [keys]Press the question mark to see every keyboard shortcut.
[two]There are two ways to ask for a change. [line]For something about the whole video, use Ask for changes, and type it in a line. [note]For something you can see, write a note.

[pause]Pause where something should change, and press Write a note, or the N key. [pinned]The note is pinned to that exact moment. [write]Say what should change, in your own words. [scope]Then choose whether it is about this moment, the whole scene, or the whole video.

[point]To show what you mean, use Point at part of the screen. [outlines]Everything with a name gets an outline. [click]Click one, and the note says what it's on. [draw]Or drag a box around anything else. [read]Muse reads the words inside, and keeps a picture of it for the agent.
[held]Your notes wait here until you send them. [edit]Until then, you can edit or delete them. [send]When you're done, press Send to the agent. [together]The agent gets all your notes at once.
[turn]Now it's the agent's turn, and each note says so. [new]When the agent has a new version, Muse shows it by itself, and says so at the top.

[yours]Notes that need you come first, marked "Your turn". [fixed]When the agent says it has fixed something, watch that moment again. [approve-fix]Then press Approve fix, or Not fixed yet to say what is still wrong. [question]If the agent asks you something, answer it in the note. [filter]These filters show only your turn, only the agent's, or the closed notes.
[closed]Approving a fix closes the note. [reopen]If the problem comes back, press reopen on it, and say what is wrong.

[track]Under the scrubber is a track of narration boxes, one bar for each. [add]To add one, press Add narration box, and click what it should outline. [bar]It appears on the track, from the sentence playing now.
[drag]Drag the edges of a bar to change when it shows and when it goes. They snap to the start of a sentence. [delete]Click a bar to select it, and you can delete it.
[tab]The Scenes tab lists every scene, with its narration. [jump]Click a time to jump there. [words]Click the narration to change the words. [voice]Only the sentences you change are voiced again.

[beats]Under the narration are the beats: what happens at each cue. [edit]Edit one to move the camera, zoom in, move the narration box, or start an animation. [pick]Press pick to choose a target on the video instead. [problems]If an edit breaks something, the tab shows an exclamation mark, and the scene says how to fix it.
[ready]When the video is right, press "Approve: it's finished". [open]If a note is still open, Muse asks first, so nothing is approved by accident.

[dialog]Muse then offers to render the final video, with the real voice. [list]It lists anything still in progress, so nothing unfinished goes out. [progress]You can keep working while it renders. [done]When it's done, play it, or open its folder. [failed]If a render fails, Muse shows why, and you can try again.
[covers]Your approval covers everything the video is made from. [changed]If anything changes later, Muse says so, and asks you to watch it again.
[recap]So your part is short: watch, leave notes, send them, check the fixes, and approve. [agent]Your agent does everything else.
